goal_text: Analyze this Python LRU cache (5 dependent steps): (1) parse eviction order, (2) identify the bug in capacity accounting when size==maxsize, (3) trace a concrete key sequence that returns a stale hit, (4) propose the minimal fix, (5) state the invariant linking dict order and linked-list integrity.
ground_truth: Bug: put evicts when len==maxsize before insert, so at capacity one put evicts then adds leaving size maxsize but order/cache can desync; stale hit if evicted key still queried; fix evict only when len>maxsize or check before insert; invariant: len(cache)==len(order) and keys match.
